rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Context Apps MCP server provides remote access to four iOS productivity applications (Todo, Idea, Journal, and Timer) through Apple ID OAuth authentication, enabling AI assistants to manage tasks, capture ideas, create journal entries with emotion tracking, and log time sessions directly within the user's existing iOS workflow. Built by Basa App, it exposes 18 specialized tools across the four categories, with features like emotion scoring for journal entries, tag-based organization, and comprehensive search capabilities, making it valuable for users who want to integrate their iOS productivity ecosystem with AI-powered task management and personal organization workflows.
